input.quote: 13.6 Independent Development: Covenant not to Sue. Nothing in this Agreement will be construed to prohibit either parties' right to independently develop the Developments contemplated above.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use covenant binds Corio (our party). Searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "Corio shall not" and "develop" surface only (i) ordinary license-scope limits on use of Commerce One's Software and MarketSite.net Service (Sections 2.1–2.7, including reverse-engineering and no-distribution limits), (ii) the "Territory" and "Corio Market Segment" definitions, which merely delimit the scope of the licenses granted to us rather than restricting the businesses we may operate or products we may buy or build, and (iii) mutual, non-restrictive provisions (Section 14.1 assignment consent for direct competitors; Section 7 mutual no-conflicting-obligation rep). Exhibit D sales and marketing cooperation is expressly "non-binding" and contains no exclusivity. Section 13.6 affirmatively preserves each party's right to develop independently, and Section 14.8 confirms Corio solely directs the Corio Services and may subcontract. Nothing survives termination as a post-term restraint on our business (Section 11.3). Accordingly the preferred position — no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer — is met and no redline is required.
